description.fun: Cobalion has a body and heart of steel, and it has carried the air of a leader since birth: one glare is enough to bring even the most ferocious Pokémon to heel. Legend says it stood with Terrakion and Virizion against humans to protect Pokémon who were losing their homes, guiding the others to safety. Takao Unno designed the trio after The Three Musketeers, with Cobalion as Athos, the eldest and their leader.
description.guide: Cobalion is a Steel- and Fighting-type Legendary Pokémon and the leader of the Swords of Justice, with Terrakion and Virizion. Legends say it fought humans to protect Pokémon. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: The steel-hearted leader of the Swords of Justice.
